subject: predict linear relationships from JAGS outputs

messages.author: 40a159cff79c9a3f
messages.subject: predict linear relationships from JAGS outputs
parts:
Hello everyone!

After repeating some times a bunch of code to make linear predictions of model parameters with covariates, I have built this function that uses the samples of the posterior distribution (jagsUI) to predict mean and 95%CI:
https://github.com/ismaelvbrack/predictJAGS_func
There is also an example with the Jay abundance from the Swiss MHB extracted from session 7.9 of AHM1 book.
Hope this will be useful for others..

Cheers,
Ismael
